# 98. Hur man utnyttjar Nvidia-rörelsen

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-11-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The host of Veckans Trade spends most of the episode on the US AI and semiconductor sell-off. He traded a sharp dip in Nvidia, Micron and Nebius for a 15-20% gain, then started cautiously buying Nvidia again after reports that CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence recruit. He argues it is a temporary crisis of confidence, not the start of an AI collapse. On the Swedish side he covers private-school stocks (AcadeMedia, Cedergrenska) rallying as a centre-right government looks more likely, a special situation in a plywood company spun off from UPM, short sellers in Castellum, and Millicom's strong report; sponsor segments add positive views on Camurus and Addnode.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host is cautiously buying back the dip around $180 after the affair/spy story and says he will keep buying on more fear.

#### Reasoning

Host sees the selloff (~30% in a month) as an overreaction to a confidence crisis. Polymarket gave only ~20% odds of Huang being ousted, too many powerful interests depend on a high Nvidia price, and the Anthropic IPO adds pressure to avoid a crash. He is buying gradually and watching news and Polymarket.

#### Sell Triggers

- Jensen Huang fired by the board
- evidence that national security secrets or chips leaked to China
- Anthropic IPO breaks

> *"Så Nvidia, jag kommer fortsatt nog köpa dippen på mer spya och rädsla, fortsatt ha koll på Pollymarket och nyhetsspridningen."*

---

### 🟢 ACAD — AcadeMedia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Prio Nilsson manager increased: political risk overdone, single-digit P/E, European acquisitions; host calls it very cheap, helped by Lööf on the board.

#### Reasoning

Guest fund manager (sponsor segment) increased the holding, citing exaggerated political risk, low Swedish ownership and diversification abroad. Host agrees it is very cheap, has pitched it before, and notes the stock rerates as a right-wing government becomes likelier.

#### Sell Triggers

- Social Democrat-led government bans profit withdrawals from schools
- acquisition strategy stalls

> *"Där var väl synen att den politiska risken var överdriven."*

---

### 🟢 ANOD-B — Addnode | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Prio Nilsson manager Martin Lindqvist added during the SaaS sell-off; valuation too low and operational improvement in Q3.

#### Reasoning

Guest fund manager opinion from a sponsor segment: he bought on a valuation de-rating across software and sees signs of operational improvement, which has already added to returns.

#### Sell Triggers

- operational improvement reverses
- software multiples compress further

> *"att värderingen blev för låg här under den här Saars-pokalypsen som var för många mjukvarubolag."*

---

### 🟢 CAMX — Camurus | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Pareto analyst Filip Wiberg says it is a top healthcare pick with good risk/reward ahead of the CAM2029 cancer readout in Q4/Q1.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion (Pareto, sponsor): an established ~SEK 3bn business at 40% EBIT margin limits the downside. A positive superiority readout could open a market up to 10x current sales, and few investors are positioned ahead of the readout. He says the readout delay is likely a good sign.

#### Sell Triggers

- negative CAM2029 cancer study readout
- further readout delays

> *"Ja, vi är positiva till Camurus och det är ett av våra topics inom hälsosektorn."*

---

### 🟢 TIGO — Millicom | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host bought the dip around $80 after the Starlink scare; the report showed revenue +61% and strong cash flow.

#### Reasoning

Host thinks the Starlink fear was overdone while the business keeps performing well. EPS was depressed by a one-off, and he likes buying dips in fundamentally strong companies.

#### Sell Triggers

- Starlink takes meaningful telecom share
- cash flow deteriorates

> *"bolaget går som tåget. jättemycket kassaflöde."*

---

### 🟢 ASML — ASML | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Cited opinion from earlier guest Jonas Olavi, who rated it 10 and a buy in a replayed clip.

#### Reasoning

This is a guest's opinion from a previous episode, replayed mockingly by the host; the host does not endorse it himself.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI capex slowdown

> *"Kinnevik 0 till 1 tolkar det som ASML. Ja, det är köp."*

---
